name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v529: Fixed Cloudflare cookie persistence across sessions - first try worked but subsequent tries failed because cf_clearance was saved under only ONE AnimePahe domain (e.g. .pw) while stream requests went to other hosts (.org, .com, www.). Now saves the cookie under ALL AnimePahe domains (.pw, .org, .com, www.) whenever any one solves. Also fixed UA mismatch: CloudflareKiller's persistSolvedCookies was saving the RAW app UA (with ; wv, Version/) overwriting the bypass dialog's CLEANED UA — cf_clearance is bound to the exact solving UA, so a mismatch re-challenges. Both paths now save the same cleaned UA. All v528 features retained: Retry Solve button, 5 post-load check intervals, www subdomain cookie harvesting, invisible WebView toggle, cookie freshness check (~30 min), probe throttle once per minute, stream-link cache ~20 min.
